protocol.joint_inputs: Unmodified recorded follower degrees and gripper percent at the original10Hz ticks; no simulated tracking states, clipping or smoothing.
protocol.action: Original achieved-motion FK delta contract: task-frame position difference and log(R_next R_current^T); recorded leader gripper percent/100 unchanged.
protocol.tool: Menagerie gripperframe lies off wrist-roll axis; no tool-site relocation.
protocol.limits: Count existing native range violations; do not clip FK input or change joint/safety limits.
protocol.base_height: Task origin is robot base; scene base_z_offset changes table/support location relative to task, not canonical base-frame FK. Camera changes do not alter recorded images or FK labels.
